headline: President Lee Jae Myung Sees Approval Rating Increase To 37 Percent
seoTitle: President Lee Jae Myung Approval Rating Rises
metaDescription: President Lee Jae Myung's job approval rating has reached 37.3 percent following two consecutive weeks of growth, according to a recent Realmeter poll.
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung recorded a 37.3 percent approval rating in a poll conducted by Realmeter.
The president's job performance rating increased by 0.9 percentage points over the past week.
The opposition People Power Party currently holds a 6.9 percentage point lead over the Democratic Party of Korea.
aiContextParagraph: Recent polling data released by Realmeter indicates a marginal rise in the public approval of South Korean President Lee Jae Myung. Based on a survey of 2,514 adults conducted between Monday and Friday of the previous week, the president's positive assessment score reached 37.3 percent, marking his highest rating in approximately one month. Simultaneously, the poll recorded a 1 percentage point decline in negative assessments, bringing that figure to 59.9 percent. Despite the upward trend in his personal approval rating, the political landscape remains competitive with the main opposition party, the People Power Party, maintaining a lead of 6.9 percentage points over the ruling Democratic Party of Korea. This data reflects the latest shifts in public opinion as monitored by Realmeter researchers tracking national sentiments toward current leadership and party affiliations.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent news outlets with a moderate coverage velocity, signaling ongoing interest in the president's political standing.
